notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Syr Ginger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to scry 1.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
